haouzia_page.hero_subtitle: Coastal stretch and lighthouse moods near El Jadida — open Atlantic air beyond the main resort strip.
haouzia_page.overview.title: Quieter Atlantic edge
haouzia_page.overview.p1: Haouzia offers a coastal change of pace from the medina walls and the busy Sidi Bouzid strip — more shoreline, wind and horizon than monuments.
haouzia_page.overview.p2: Come for a walk, lighthouse silhouettes and open Atlantic light. Services are lighter; bring water and a layer against the breeze.
haouzia_page.overview.p3: It works as a flexible add-on when you have already seen the Portuguese core and want one more sea hour.

haouzia_page.faq.title: Haouzia Coast FAQ
haouzia_page.faq.q1.question: How do I get there?
haouzia_page.faq.q1.answer: Taxi from the centre; agree the price and return plan.
haouzia_page.faq.q2.question: Beach or cliffs?
haouzia_page.faq.q2.answer: A mix of coastal stretch — check the exact access point with your driver.
haouzia_page.faq.q3.question: Swimming?
haouzia_page.faq.q3.answer: Only if conditions are clearly safe; this is open Atlantic.
haouzia_page.faq.q4.question: Worth it without a car?
haouzia_page.faq.q4.answer: Yes with a taxi; not a long monument visit.
haouzia_page.faq.q5.question: Best time?
haouzia_page.faq.q5.answer: Late afternoon for softer light and cooler air.
